source_user: An agent repeatedly calls a calculator when the answer is already known. Design metrics and an intervention. Scenario variant 81: include an explicit falsifiable hypothesis and a controlled experiment.
source_assistant: Answer should state assumptions, a falsifiable hypothesis, measurements, expected confounders, and rollback criteria. Minimum technical points: measure unnecessary calls, tool success, final correctness, trajectory length, tool latency, and recovery; add a stop/no-tool evaluation and preference or reward signal.
corrected_answer:
Assume a pinned model/policy, calculator version, precision target, workload mix, and correctness adjudicator; these are assumptions, not measured platform facts. Define an unnecessary call as a calculator invocation that a no-tool policy would answer correctly at the required precision from the supplied information. A call is justified for large or error-prone arithmetic, unit conversion, uncertainty propagation, missing intermediate values, or explicit verification; ambiguous inputs or precision require a question or abstention, never a guess.

Intervene with a typed stop/no-tool gate: estimate task difficulty and required precision, allow a calculator only when its expected correctness benefit exceeds tool latency/cost, and cap retries. Log policy/model/tool versions, task class and difficulty, gate decision and rationale, call count, expression hash (not raw sensitive content), success/error/timeout, tool and end-to-end wall-clock latency in milliseconds, token/cost impact, final correctness, trajectory length, retries, abstentions, and recovery. Report unnecessary-call rate, justified-use rate, tool success/error/timeout, final correctness, trajectory length, p50/p95/p99 latency, cost, and recovery with confidence intervals, stratified by task class, difficulty, input size, precision, and load.

For this scenario variant, pre-register: on a locked held-out set, compared with the current policy, the gate will reduce unnecessary-call rate by at least 20% relative and p95 end-to-end latency by at least 10 ms, while final correctness is non-inferior within 1 percentage point and justified-call recall is not lower than 98%. Randomize tasks and paired policy assignment, tune only on a disjoint development set, use the same seeds/load/tool budget, and evaluate no-tool, tool-required, ambiguous, malformed, adversarial-output, timeout, wrong-result, and retry-loop cases. Include preference/reward shaping for correct concise trajectories, but audit it against correctness and abstention so it cannot reward unsafe tool avoidance.

Expected confounders are task mix, arithmetic difficulty, load/cache effects, model or tool version, evaluator disagreement, and prompt/order effects; block or stratify randomization and report uncertainty. Redact content, retain salted hashes and bounded telemetry, restrict tool permissions, validate tool outputs, and isolate failure tests. Roll back the gate if correctness misses the margin, justified-use recall falls, unsafe answers/abstentions or timeout/retry rates rise, privacy/security alerts occur, or latency/cost SLOs regress; canary gradually and retain a kill switch. Results are provisional and require domain-expert review.

Randomize tasks and paired policy assignment, tune only on a disjoint development set, use the same seeds/load/tool budget, and evaluate no-tool, tool-required, ambiguous, malformed, adversarial-output, timeout, wrong-result, and retry-loop cases. Include preference/reward shaping for correct concise trajectories, but audit it against correctness and abstention so it cannot reward unsafe tool avoidance.

Expected confounders are task mix, arithmetic difficulty, load/cache effects, model or tool version, evaluator disagreement, and prompt/order effects; block or stratify randomization and report uncertainty. Redact content, retain salted hashes and bounded telemetry, restrict tool permissions, validate tool outputs, and isolate failure tests. Roll back the gate if correctness misses the margin, justified-use recall falls, unsafe answers/abstentions or timeout/retry rates rise, privacy/security alerts occur, or latency/cost SLOs regress; canary gradually and retain a kill switch. Results are provisional and require domain-expert review.

quality_dimensions.coverage: covers requirements, mechanisms, boundaries, failure modes, measurement, assumptions, and safety limits
quality_dimensions.correctness: uses operational definitions, units, and falsifiable non-inferiority criteria
quality_dimensions.completeness: includes intervention, controlled experiment, confounders, recovery, reward safeguards, and rollback
quality_dimensions.clarity: structured, measurable, and distinguishes assumptions from evidence

risks: tool avoidance may reduce correctness or justified-use recall
synthetic labels and evaluator disagreement may bias reward
adversarial or private expressions may leak through telemetry
latency and cost effects may vary by load, task mix, or versions
